mapper.select: SELECT O.OPPTY_ID, O.CUST_ID, C.CUST_NM, O.OPPTY_NM, O.STAGE_CD, O.EXPECT_AMT, O.EXPECT_CLOSE_DT, O.CHARGE_USER_ID, O.STATUS_CD, O.REG_DT, O.UPD_DT FROM TB_OPPTY O LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CUSTOMER C ON C.CUST_ID = O.CUST_ID WHERE O.OPPTY_ID = #{opptyId}
SELECT OPPTY_ID, CUST_ID, OPPTY_NM, STAGE_CD, EXPECT_AMT, EXPECT_CLOSE_DT FROM TB_OPPTY WHERE STATUS_CD = '10' ORDER BY EXPECT_CLOSE_DT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_OPPTY (OPPTY_ID, CUST_ID, OPPTY_NM, STAGE_CD, EXPECT_AMT, EXPECT_CLOSE_DT, CHARGE_USER_ID, STATUS_CD, REG_DT) VALUES (#{opptyId}, #{custId}, #{opptyNm}, '10', #{expectAmt}, #{expectCloseDt}, #{chargeUserId}, '10', NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_OPPTY SET STAGE_CD = #{stageCd}, STATUS_CD = CASE WHEN #{stageCd} IN ('40', '90') THEN '90' ELSE '10' END, UPD_DT = NOW() WHERE OPPTY_ID = #{opptyId}
